findings.claim: A public German company directory lists Daraja UG (haftungsbeschränkt) as active, registered in August 2024 under HRB 21203 in Memmingen.
The same public directory reports registered capital of EUR 2,400; this is a legal-capital fact, not revenue, budget or contract capacity.
Daraja's owned site publishes operating contact locations in Germany and Kenya and presents four service families spanning business advisory, cultural learning, events and travel.
The services page publishes a four-step commercial process beginning with a free consultation and progressing through proposal, quote, work plan, contract, analysis, implementation and follow-up.
Daraja's owned site lists a Security Essen / Euro Defence Expo delegation trip for 22-25 September 2026.

value.event: Security Essen / Euro Defence Expo Delegation Trip 2026

findings.claim: No independently supportable revenue, employee count, paid contract value, customer volume or current pricing was established in this bounded pass.

unresolved_questions: Published client volume, revenue or contract evidence sufficient to assess budget capacity.
Whether the September 2026 delegation is actively selling places and at what price.
Whether the Nairobi address represents staffed operations or a contact location.
